answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if peer attestations expose duplicate identities. Creating many Sybils multiplies the locked capital, so an attacker must fund every fake separately, like buying a distinct pigment for each forgery instead of reusing one. Honest agents recover their stake at a checkpoint, while fakes perched on the ledge of the system echo the same behavior and lose their deposits when correlated.
